newsFlag.summary: Juszczyk (finger) did not practice Tuesday despite practicing Monday, though this may be veteran management rather than a serious concern.
Undisclosed
Personal
Mike Evans is dealing with a groin/adductor injury and will miss practice this week, with the team hoping to have him back next week before the season opener on September 10 in Australia.
Darren Waller is being eased into practice with the Panthers after recently signing and is not expected to play in the preseason finale, but there is no reported injury.
Marcus Mariota is recovering from a sprained MCL in his right knee suffered on Aug. 14 and has returned to practice with plans to increase his workload.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey participated fully in practice drills while in uniform and continues trending positively toward Week 1 availability despite an undisclosed injury.
Kittle is recovering from an Achilles injury and will be eased back into practice with his availability for Week 1 against the Rams still uncertain.

Deshaun Watson was named the Browns' starting quarterback after winning a preseason job battle, though he has a history of significant injuries including a torn Achilles tendon and re-rupture that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky is day-to-day with a biceps injury sustained Monday and did not participate in Wednesday's practice, though the injury is not considered a major concern.
Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 against the Broncos despite recovering from a torn left ACL sustained last December, with growing confidence he will be available for the 2026 season opener.

Alvin Kamara sustained an MCL sprain and is expected to be out for at least one month, putting his Week 1 availability in jeopardy and making him a candidate to open the season on injured reserve for at least four games.
Jeremy McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and cannot return until at least Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Ray-Ray McCloud was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury and must miss at least four games to start the season.
Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be available for Week 1.
Jakobi Meyers jammed his right hand during Wednesday's joint practice and is questionable for Jacksonville's preseason finale, with unclear availability for upcoming practices.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.

Hockenson is active and remains the Vikings' top tight end on the depth chart, though he saw limited offensive snaps (5) in preseason play and continues his recovery trajectory following a 2023 ACL/MCL injury.
Singletary is not in uniform for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, though this appears to be a rest decision rather than an injury concern.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers with an undisclosed injury and cannot return until Week 5.

Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with limited fantasy relevance due to his low touch average and third-string role behind James Cook and Ray Davis.
Undisclosed
Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but has returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
A.J. Brown is not in uniform for Thursday's preseason game and won't see any game action during the exhibition season, though he is expected to be the Patriots' top target in 2026.
Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List following misdemeanor charges from a domestic incident and is ineligible to practice or play pending his court appearance on November 17.
Dobbins was cleared to return to practice after a soft-tissue injury and is expected to be the Broncos' top running back this season, though his preseason availability remains uncertain.
Pittman is dealing with a hamstring injury but is expected to be ready for Week 1 after missing training camp and preseason action.
AJ Dillon played in the preseason game and is active, but could see increased role if other Panthers RBs (Hubbard, Etienne) suffer lingering injuries heading into Week 1.
Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills, though he played in the previous preseason opener and appears to be rested for this particular game.
Tee Higgins is managing a heel contusion ahead of Week 1, but coach Zac Taylor indicated he should be ready for the Bengals' opener against Tampa Bay.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday while recovering from a hamstring injury sustained in mid-August and is trending positively toward being ready for the start of the season.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Brock Wright is active and caught a pass in preseason action, with potential increased opportunity if Sam LaPorta's hip injury keeps him out of Week 1.
Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring clearance from an independent neurologist before he can play in Week 1.
Ja'Marr Chase sustained a left knee hyperextension injury during practice but is expected to return as a limited participant this week and should be ready for the Week 1 opener against Tampa Bay.
DeVonta Smith is a full participant in practice after returning in limited capacity last week, continuing to ramp up from a hamstring injury.
Travis Etienne is healthy and expected to see an increased workload early in the season due to teammate Alvin Kamara's knee injury.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons for an undisclosed injury and will be unable to participate in 2026 unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was waived/injured by Miami and has reverted to the Dolphins' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury, requiring an injury settlement to potentially play in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and will miss at least through Week 4.
Melton is active and healthy but faces roster uncertainty due to poor preseason performance and competition for his special teams role.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to an undisclosed preseason injury and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Isiah Pacheco was placed on injured reserve by the Detroit Lions due to a back injury suffered during training camp, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Cameron Dicker is working through an unspecified issue but head coach Jim Harbaugh is not concerned about his availability for Week 1 against the Cardinals.
Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury sustained Aug. 19 and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is making progress in recovery.
Khalil Shakir has been sidelined since Aug. 20 with an undisclosed injury and missed the final two preseason games, leaving limited time before the regular season opener on Sept. 13.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during a preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.
Chris Oladokun was placed on the Chiefs' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Skylar Thompson has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Brittain Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Bears due to an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Groin
Alec Pierce is recovering from offseason ankle surgery, missed most of training camp and preseason, but the Colts hope he'll be available for Week 1 against Baltimore.
Calvin Austin III was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Wan'Dale Robinson sustained a hard hit during Thursday's joint practice but concussion tests came back negative, with early indications suggesting he is on track to play in Week 1.
Breece Hall is recovering from a minor groin strain and participating in limited agility drills, with focus on returning for Week 1 rather than the preseason game.
Cade Otton returned to practice after missing about a week with an undisclosed injury and is expected to be available for the 2026 season.
Kenneth Walker III is dealing with ankle swelling but is expected to be fine with no extended absence anticipated according to head coach Andy Reid.
Will Mallory was placed on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest return date being Week 5.
Mitchell has missed four straight practices due to an undisclosed injury but is doing side work with a trainer and is expected to play in Week 1.
Kendre Miller exited Tuesday's practice with an apparent injury, though there's no indication it's serious, leaving the team's running back depth depleted with Kamara also sidelined.
Undisclosed
Scott Matlock was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Brayden Willis was ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders due to a concussion.

Tyrell Shavers was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a torn ACL suffered in the wild-card round and will miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season, with the earliest return being Week 5.
Knee
Princeton Fant has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jake Bobo sustained a serious knee injury during a joint practice with the Titans and was placed on injured reserve, making him unavailable for the entire 2026 season.
Nate Adkins suffered an undisclosed injury during Friday practice but returned to participate in Monday's training camp practice, suggesting the injury is minor.
Emanuel Wilson has been designated as Questionable for upcoming games.
Undisclosed
Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the preseason finale and missed practice Monday, but has two weeks to recover before the regular season opener.
Tank Dell is on injured reserve with a knee injury and must miss at least the first four games, though the GM indicates he is getting closer to returning.
Addison played in the preseason opener after jamming his thumb in training camp but appears to be recovering well with no current availability concerns.
Tucker Kraft is expected to be 'full go' for Week 1 after recovering from a torn ACL sustained 10 months prior, though he is being rested in the preseason finale as a precaution.
Josh Downs sustained a minor calf injury that caused him to miss some practice time last week, but he participated in Tuesday's practice and is expected to be off the injury report by Week 1.
De'Von Achane is not in uniform for Saturday's preseason game against the Giants, sitting out the exhibition matchup alongside QB Malik Willis.
Zay Flowers is recovering from a left quadriceps bruise sustained on Aug. 8 but is expected to return to full practice next week and be available for the Ravens' season opener on Sept. 13.
Sam LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday after a hip injury and is trending positively with over two weeks to recover before Week 1.

Rashee Rice returned to game action for the first time since a December concussion and is expected to be the Chiefs' top WR for Week 1, though his recent offseason issues (jail time, knee procedure) warrant monitoring.
Davis Allen is recovering from a quadriceps injury and participated in limited practice Monday, with expected availability for the regular-season opener.
Puka Nacua (groin) is ramping up gradually and was off to the side during team drills at Monday's practice, but is expected to be available for Week 1.

Luke Musgrave was placed on the PUP list and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 season due to a neck injury sustained during June minicamp, with an uncertain return timeline even after becoming eligible in Week 5.
Jayden Reed is being rested and will not play in Friday's preseason game against Denver, though he is healthy and previously missed only brief practice time.
Zach Charbonnet suffered an ACL tear in his left knee on January 17 and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
Johnny Wilson was placed on Philadelphia's injured reserve due to a knee injury and will miss the entire season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chris Collier reverted to injured reserve with the Raiders due to an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless an injury settlement is reached.
Undisclosed
Malik Nabers (knee) missed the open portion of Tuesday's practice but returned in uniform midway through, though he remains uncertain about Week 1 availability.
Xavier Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice and will remain in a walking boot until Thursday, making him likely to miss Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
Jonathon Brooks missed Tuesday practice due to general soreness but the injury does not appear serious after his preseason performance.
Irving is healthy heading into the 2026 season after missing seven games in 2025, and participated in preseason action with increased offensive touches.
Guerendo was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a pectoral injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
Groin
Jamari Thrash has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Tracy suffered a neck stinger in the preseason finale but avoided major injury and is practicing in a non-contact jersey.
Joe Milton III was waived by the Cowboys, removing him from the team's roster and making him unavailable for fantasy purposes.
Xavier Weaver has been designated as Questionable for upcoming game availability.
Carter Bradley suffered a thumb injury in the final preseason game and has been placed on Jacksonville's injured reserve, likely missing the entire 2026 season.
British Brooks returned to practice Monday after undergoing hand surgery in early August and a three-week absence, and is working to be ready for Friday's preseason finale.
Mason Tipton was placed on the reserve/PUP list after offseason tibia surgery and is sidelined for at least the first four weeks of the regular season, with the earliest return possible in Week 5.
Cole Burgess has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Jeshaun Jones received a three-game NFL suspension for violating the substance-abuse policy and will be ineligible for game action until Week 4.
Tip Reiman was moved to reserve/PUP list due to an ankle injury and must miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.

Braelon Allen started at RB in place of the injured Breece Hall and is the team's top available RB, though Hall is expected back by Week 1 and Isaiah Davis could compete for backup duties once healthy.
Isaiah Davis (knee) has missed the first two preseason games and worked out on a sidefield Tuesday, with his availability for Friday's preseason game against the Giants still uncertain.
MarShawn Lloyd is the top available option in the Packers backfield with Josh Jacobs sidelined, presenting a short-term fantasy opportunity despite limited regular-season experience.
Erick All passed his conditioning test and is cleared to participate in training camp after undergoing multiple knee surgeries for an ACL injury that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
Theo Johnson is participating in non-contact practice after a shoulder injury sustained last Monday and appears on track to play Week 1 against the Cowboys.
McMillan remains sidelined with a knee injury at practice but is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Bengals in 12 days.

Brian Thomas Jr. suffered a shoulder injury Tuesday but returned to practice Wednesday in limited capacity, with the team being cautious about his availability for the preseason finale but optimistic for the season opener.
Keon Coleman is recovering from a sprained right foot/toe sustained in the preseason opener and has progressed to practicing without a walking boot, with nearly two weeks to recover before Week 1.
Undisclosed
Jayden Daniels is active and returning from an elbow injury that caused him to miss the final four games of the 2025 regular season, with limited preseason snaps as he works back to full form.
Ben Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and is unlikely to play in Friday's preseason finale, though his availability for the Sept. 13 season opener is not currently in jeopardy.
Knee - PCL
Penix is recovering from a torn ACL in his left knee and will miss Friday's preseason game, but expects to be available for Week 1 against the Steelers pending further recovery.
Trey Benson reverted to the Cardinals' injured reserve list after knee surgery for a meniscus injury and was unable to stay healthy or productive upon return.
J.J. McCarthy remains on the Vikings' 53-man roster with an ankle injury but will serve as a backup quarterback behind Kyler Murray.
Thomas Yassmin was placed on injured reserve by the Packers and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Savion Williams is on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain and is expected to be eligible to return in Week 5 (October 11 vs. Bears).
Tyler Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties despite recent missed field goals in the preseason and the Ravens adding Jake Moody to the practice squad, putting him on a short leash.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs due to an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Ashton Jeanty is recovering from an ankle injury sustained Aug. 23 and is making progress working with trainers, but his Week 1 status has not yet been confirmed.
Tyler Warren (adductor strain) participated in Tuesday's practice and is expected to operate with no restrictions for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Egbuka is not practicing due to a toe injury sustained in mid-August, and his Week 1 availability remains uncertain despite coach Todd Bowles expressing hopefulness about his return.
Jayden Higgins was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL in practice, ending his 2026 season before it began.
Hamstring
Ayomanor exited Thursday's practice early with a left shoulder issue but is practicing Friday with no serious injury apparent.
Jordan James returned from a rib fracture to play in the preseason game with limited touches, showing he is progressing well but may still need monitoring as the regular season approaches.

Ollie Gordon II suffered a minor rib injury during preseason but would have been cleared to return in a regular season game, with his practice participation this week determining his preseason finale availability.
Devin Neal was placed on injured reserve with a hamstring injury sustained during preseason and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Will Howard suffered a concussion during preseason and is in the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring evaluation by an independent neurologist before returning to practice.
Kalel Mullings has been designated as questionable for an upcoming game.
Knee - ACL
Kyle Monangai is week-to-week with a right knee hyperextension suffered in practice on Aug. 16 and is at risk of being limited or sidelined for the Bears' season opener on Sept. 13.
Johnson returned to action in preseason after missing two games due to an Aug. 4 groin strain and caught one pass on one target.
LeQuint Allen Jr. is listed as questionable for the upcoming game.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.

Croskey-Merritt missed the final two preseason games due to a lower-body injury and is expected to return to practice next week, with his participation level to be determined before the regular-season opener.
Moliki Matavao was placed on injured reserve due to a knee injury sustained during a preseason game and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Jacoby Jones was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will need to negotiate a settlement with the Commanders to avoid spending the entire 2026 regular season on IR.
Ja'Quinden Jackson was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury after being waived by Philadelphia and not claimed by another team, though CT scans came back negative.
Coleman Owen was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to a concussion suffered during the preseason finale and will miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Beaux Collins was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return, requiring him to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to an undisclosed injury.
Carter Runyon was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to return until Week 5.
Dontae Fleming was placed on injured reserve by the Vikings with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Corey Kiner was traded to the Patriots and is positioned as the No. 3 running back, with potential to see increased opportunity if TreVeyon Henderson's ankle injury causes him to miss time.
Brock Lampe was placed on injured reserve after being waived with an injury designation and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Arm
Thornton was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Kurtis Rourke suffered three broken ribs in the preseason opener but has a chance to return next week according to Coach Shanahan.
Campbell suffered a significant leg injury during practice and has been placed on injured reserve for the 2026 regular season.
Trevor Etienne was placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury suffered in Friday's preseason finale and will miss at least four games.
Tory Horton is sidelined with an undisclosed injury but head coach Mike Macdonald indicated it is not a long-term concern.
Robbie Ouzts has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Hampton was limited in preseason action but is listed as active and remains the Chargers' lead back despite a fractured left ankle that limited him to nine games last season.
Dillon Gabriel was placed on injured reserve with a non-serious back injury to start the 2026 season, requiring him to miss at least the first four games.
Tre Harris missed the final two preseason games with an undisclosed injury but is not expected to miss the regular-season opener against the Cardinals.
TreVeyon Henderson is rehabbing a right ankle injury and hasn't been cleared for full participation in practice ahead of Week 1 against the Seahawks.

Luther Burden III is recovering from a groin injury suffered in early August and has returned to practice participation, but his Week 1 availability remains uncertain after missing the entire preseason.
Terrance Ferguson is dealing with soreness and working off to the side at practice, but remains available and in consideration for offensive contributions.
Isaiah Bond is listed as questionable for the upcoming game.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Sarratt is healthy but faces significant roster competition and decreased production in preseason games, putting his spot on the 53-man roster at risk.
Adam Randall was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens with an undisclosed injury and a designation to return, making him ineligible to play until at least October 11.
Jaren Kanak has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Dominic Richardson was placed on the Jets' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
DJ Rogers suffered an MCL sprain during preseason and has been placed on injured reserve for the entire 2026 regular season.
Jeff Caldwell hyperextended his left knee during practice and has been placed on injured reserve for the 2026 regular season.
Knee
EJ Smith was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chase Roberts reverted to the Raiders' IR with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Undisclosed

Jeremiyah Love is recovering from a high-ankle sprain suffered in preseason Week 1 and was spotted at practice but not suited up, with his availability for the Week 1 opener against the Chargers still uncertain pending further participation in drills.
Jordyn Tyson was placed on injured reserve with a right hamstring injury and is expected to miss at least the first four games of the season, with a potential two-month recovery timeline.
Kenyon Sadiq (hernia) is on track to play Week 1 but missed most of training camp and preseason, so he will have a limited role initially while ramping up activity over the next 10 days.
De'Zhaun Stribling is sidelined with a shoulder injury and will miss Thursday's preseason game against Las Vegas but is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Rams.
Oscar Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at Saints training camp with unclear severity ahead of the preseason finale.
Ted Hurst III is active but faces reduced playing time in Week 1 if injured receivers ahead of him on the depth chart (Egbuka, McMillan, Johnson) return to availability.
Joe Royer was placed on the reserve/non-football illness list and is required to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to a personal issue.
Kaytron Allen is healthy and expected to begin the regular season as the third-string running back, with potential for increased workload if injuries to ahead-of-him teammates persist into Week 1.
Undisclosed
Carsen Ryan returned to action in Thursday's preseason game after exiting Tuesday's practice early with a foot injury, catching both targets for nine yards.
Haynes King suffered a hamstring injury in the Hall of Fame Game and will miss the final three preseason games, putting his roster spot in jeopardy.
Undisclosed
Quentin Moore was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Chase Curtis suffered a knee injury during preseason and was placed on injured reserve, requiring an injury settlement with the Jets to have any chance of playing in 2026.
Chip Trayanum was placed on injured reserve due to a neck injury suffered in the preseason finale and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Myles Montgomery has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jameson Geers has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Sincere Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Chargers with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Matthew Caldwell was placed on injured reserve by the Rams due to an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Carnell Tate missed Tuesday's practice due to stiffness but is expected to be available for Week 1 with no indication his status is in danger.

Eli Stowers is dealing with a hamstring injury that may limit his gameday availability even after recovery, and he's currently fourth on the tight-end depth chart behind Goedert, Mundt, and Calcaterra.
Boerkircher sat out Friday's preseason game but is listed as active, likely receiving rest as a rookie competing for the TE2 role.
Jadarian Price has recovered from his lower-body injury and will be available for Week 1, though he is being rested for the preseason finale.
Will Kacmarek is week-to-week with an undisclosed injury and did not play in the preseason finale.
Bell returned to game action in the preseason after ACL surgery in December and is competing for playing time in the Dolphins' receiver room.
Coleman returned from an undisclosed injury to play in Saturday's preseason game, catching 2 of 5 targets for 32 yards, but faces significant depth chart competition.

Brenen Thompson was held out of Saturday's practice due to an undisclosed injury but returned to the field Sunday wearing a non-contact jersey, indicating he is progressing but still being managed cautiously.
Connor Hulstein was placed on injured reserve by the Jets with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
